Craftsmanship

From Concept to Presentation

Each ring travels through seven disciplines and fourteen stages inside our own manufacturing atelier — never outsourced, never hurried.

Design

Hand sketches resolve proportion, weight and stance on the hand.

CAD

Micron-level modelling of every wall, seat and gallery.

Casting

Investment casting in certified 14K & 18K gold alloys.

Setting

Pavé, channel, bezel and tension work under 10× magnification.

Polishing

Mirror, satin and sandblast finishes applied by hand.

Quality

Stone-count, weight and finish audited against the master file.

Presentation

Photographed, certified and cased for the world's counters.

Brand Story

A Maison Built on Precision

Star Jewellery was founded on the manufacturing floors of Surat — the city that cuts the world's diamonds — with a conviction that men's jewellery deserved the same architectural rigour as a great timepiece.

Today the house designs and produces every piece in its own atelier: a fourteen-stage pipeline where CAD engineers, casters, setters and polishers work metres apart. The result is jewellery with the tolerances of an instrument and the presence of an heirloom.
